title: Noisy, works great on twig size branches.
text:
Noisy, works great on twig size branches.. Not very strong. I tried to cut through between a 1/4" and 1/2" limb and ended up breaking the limb because it wouldn't cut all the way through. It's great for small twig type branches but it's slow and struggles with anything bigger. It's also noisy, not that it matters outdoors, but hey, there just might be a bird sitting on a nest, you don't want to scare off.

I would spend my money on something better.

description: PRUNE LIKE A PRO! Sun Joe takes the ache out of one of gardening's most repetitive tasks. Prune your way to a greener yard and garden with Sun Joe PJ3600C 3.6-Volt Cordless Pruner. Proper pruning encourages plants to thrive, and is key to maintaining, healthy flowering plants and fruit trees. Ideal for green wood, woody stems, twigs and branches up to 1/2-inch, Sun Joe's cordless pruner provides a clean, precise cut to allow your plant to heal, while eliminating the stress and strain associated with squeezing conventional manual pruners. Cutting is as simple as squeezing the trigger, and when fully charged the cordless pruner provides up to 750 cuts on a single charge. An ergonomic handle provides a secure, comfortable grip, a built-in safety switch prevents accidental cuts, and dual onboard LEDs put a little light on the trimming task for enhanced visibility indoors. Give your green thumb a helping hand, and Go With Joe - for perfectly pruned plants!
